title: Pique-led protest against Santokhi government policy and continued tenure
location: Dr Sophie Redmondstraat; along Waterkant to Independence Square opposite the National Assembly, Paramaribo
organizer: Activist Sibrano (also spelled Siebrano) Pique; formal organization not established
participants_original: Waterkant reported about 200 at Independence Square; its 10 January follow-up reported between 100 and 200 for the Saturday protest. Starnieuws described the turnout as 'dozens'. The reports differ in precision and estimate.
threshold_50_evidence: Waterkant's 9 January report says the group grew to about 200 at Independence Square; its 10 January follow-up explicitly gives 100–200 for the 9 January action. That published range clears 50. Starnieuws' separate description was 'dozens'; retain the discrepancy and do not treat Waterkant's two accounts as independent.

title.summary: Both reports identify Pique's protest and chants for President Santokhi ('Chan') to leave; Waterkant reports a demand to speak with a National Assembly member.

start_date.summary: Waterkant dates its contemporaneous report to 9 January 2021 and says the group assembled that morning; Starnieuws published on 10 January and calls the gathering Saturday, 9 January.

start_precision.summary: The physical gathering is dated to 9 January.

end_date.summary: Waterkant's same-day update says Pique thanked attendees and the square emptied after Bee said he would not attend that day.

end_precision.summary: Physical departure is described on the date of the gathering; no time is reported.

location.summary: Waterkant says the group assembled on Dr Sophie Redmondstraat, walked along Waterkant and stood at Independence Square opposite the National Assembly.

scope.summary: The reported assembly and route were in Paramaribo.

organizer.summary: Reports identify activist Sibrano/Siebrano Pique as the initiator and a visible leader; no formal organization is established.

demands.summary: The action opposed the government's policy, called for Chan Santokhi to leave, and displayed 'Stop de IMF deal'; coded political behavior/process and removal of politician.

participants_original.summary: Waterkant's Jan 9 report says circa 200; its Jan 10 follow-up says 100–200; Starnieuws calls the group 'dozens'. Preserve the difference.

participants_min.summary: Waterkant's Jan 10 report gives an explicit 100–200 range for the 9 January gathering.

participants_max.summary: Waterkant's Jan 10 report gives an explicit 100–200 range for the 9 January gathering.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The 100–200 report and circa-200 contemporaneous report exceed 50, while Starnieuws' less precise 'dozens' is preserved as a conflicting description.

protester_violence.summary: The reviewed accounts do not establish a physical attack or explicit nonviolence; unknown retained.

state_response.accommodation.summary: Bee's promised future conversation with Pique was not shown as completed; no actual receipt or meeting established for this event.

state_response.arrests.summary: No arrest response is established in the reports reviewed; unknown retained.

state_response.beatings.summary: No beating response is established in the reports reviewed; unknown retained.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: The article says the square emptied after Pique thanked participants; it does not attribute departure to state dispersal.

state_response.ignore.summary: No National Assembly member was present when the group asked to speak; a future conversation was offered. Intentional avoidance/refusal is not established, so unknown.

state_response.killings.summary: No state killing response is established; unknown retained.

state_response.shootings.summary: No state shooting response is established; unknown retained.

eligibility.summary: Occurrence, date, domestic government target and threshold are supported. Starnieuws says Pique had earlier actions since the government took office; with earlier dates and event boundaries unresolved, monthly ownership remains pending_unit.

notes: The 9 January public gathering is directly reported. Waterkant reported about 200; its follow-up gave 100–200; Starnieuws described 'dozens'. Waterkant and Starnieuws are separate outlets, but no independent headcount methodology was reported. Starnieuws says Pique had conducted actions since the government took office, without dates or evidence that those earlier actions met the public-gathering threshold. January ownership and the boundary between later announced actions remain open.
open_questions: Verify when Pique's earlier actions began and whether a qualifying gathering or continuous episode started before January 2021.
Determine whether announced actions on 11 January and 20 January actually occurred and whether they form new episodes.
Verify whether the promised conversation with Assembly chair Bee and petition receipt happened.
Official baseline, additional Coding Procedure and coordinator review remain pending.

title: Pique-led protest and petition presentation on IMF, civil-service pay, prices and exchange rate
location: Paramaribo; exact protest site not stated. Petition was presented to the National Assembly chair.
participants_original: Waterkant reported circa 100 people in attendance. Pre-event reports projected about 500, which was an expected count and not observed turnout.
threshold_50_evidence: Waterkant's 20 January report says about 100 people answered Pique's call. This approximate observed figure is above 50. The earlier estimate of about 500 was projected turnout, not a count of people who attended.

title.summary: The reports identify Pique's 20 January protest against government policy and the IMF agreement.

start_date.summary: ABC on 19 January announced a protest for the next day; Waterkant dates the actual gathering and petition handover to 20 January; a later report calls 20 January the protest day.

start_precision.summary: Waterkant gives the gathering date as 20 January 2021.

end_date.summary: The article reports petition receipt and a short address but not when participants physically departed; no end date assigned.

end_precision.summary: No physical ending date/time is stated; unknown.

location.summary: The permit was handled by the Paramaribo North-East district commissioner and the petition went to the National Assembly chair; exact assembly location is not stated in the opened report.

scope.summary: The permit account concerns Paramaribo; the reported gathering was a local action.

organizer.summary: Reports identify activist Sibrano Pique as the caller and organizer.

demands.summary: The petition opposed government IMF agreements, requested a solution for civil servants without pay or sent home, and raised high prices and the exchange rate.

participants_original.summary: ABC and government sources projected roughly 500 before the event; Waterkant reported circa 100 actual attendees. The linked circa-100 report is the same outlet and inaccessible.

participants_min.summary: No explicit lower bound was published; null retained.

participants_max.summary: No explicit upper bound was published; null retained.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Waterkant reports circa 100 actual attendees, which is clearly above 50; expected attendance of 500 is not substituted for observed turnout.

protester_violence.summary: The reviewed report does not establish physical violence or explicit nonviolence; unknown retained.

state_response.accommodation.summary: National Assembly chair Marinus Bee accepted Pique's petition and spoke briefly; this is an actual response, not evidence that demands were granted.

state_response.arrests.summary: A separate article reports Pique's arrest at home on 23 January under a narcotics-law allegation, but it does not link that arrest to the protest; no event arrest is established.

state_response.beatings.summary: No beating response is established in the reviewed reports; unknown retained.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: Before the event, the district commissioner refused the permit, urged Pique not to protest and warned that people who gathered would face consequences. Code as an attributed attempted effort to prevent/deter the gathering, not successful clearing; Waterkant reports that about 100 still attended.

state_response.ignore.summary: Bee accepted the petition and spoke to Pique, so explicit ignoring at the event is not supported; later handling of demands is unknown.

state_response.killings.summary: No state killing response is established; unknown retained.

state_response.shootings.summary: No shooting response is established; unknown retained.

eligibility.summary: A physical gathering, Paramaribo context, government policy demands and approximate turnout above 50 are reported. It may be part of the same Pique campaign as 9 January; unit boundary awaits review.

notes: Waterkant reports circa 100 actual attendees on 20 January, versus about 500 projected in pre-event accounts. The chair of the National Assembly accepted the petition and spoke briefly despite the denied permit. The 9 January gathering ended physically that day, while the 20 January gathering was a new public action 11 days later; whether MM treats them as separate events or one campaign episode remains unresolved. A separate 23 January arrest under a narcotics-law allegation is not coded as a protest response.
open_questions: Determine the episode boundary between the 9 January and 20 January gatherings using the missing additional Coding Procedure and coordinator review.
Verify the exact protest location and physical end time.
Clarify whether the pre-event permit refusal/warning is coded as an attempted crowd-dispersal response in this schema.
Determine whether the 23 January arrest had any relation to protest activity; no link is asserted here.
